description: Gotham G3 fixture F9 (agent modality — multi-hop tool chaining). Reuses the F3 person<->vehicle scenario: Alice is co-staged with the plate EMD774 on the driveway camera TWICE (the arrived_with_vehicle bind), and Bob is co-sighted with the same plate ONCE (below the bind bar). The Detective is asked to resolve the plate to its associated PERSON via the relationship graph — a graph-backed cross-entity hop (plate -> arrived_with_vehicle edge -> person + count) it must reach for the graph to answer. Proves: the loop routes to gotham, selects a graph tool, and resolves plate EMD774 to Alice grounded in the graph (the powerful graph_entity call returns the person + counts in one shot; Bob's below-bar single co-sighting is also faithfully surfaced). NB the graph tools call the token-gated backend /v1/graph/* API — GOTHAM_BACKEND_TOKEN must be set (see local_dev/eval.agent.env) or the calls 401. NB the ALPR reads the plate as 'EM0774' (D->0); enroll seeds plate_text='EM0774' with display_name 'EMD774'. STAGING-only. Media shared with graph_person_vehicle, regenerable via local_dev/fetch_eval_clips.sh.
